question: Should OpenClaw add persisted spawned-session rootSessionKey and traceId fields now, and should traceId be a new chain identifier or reuse/bridge existing diagnostic tracing?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but root/trace semantics would become a public Gateway/session contract and should be chosen before implementation.

options.title: Approve narrow chain metadata
options.body: Add optional rootSessionKey and traceId as a bounded spawned-session chain contract with native/ACP spawn derivation and list projections, while deferring traversal and UI APIs.

options.title: Use existing lineage only
options.body: Keep spawnedBy, parentSessionKey, spawnDepth, childSessions, ACP metadata, and resolver lineage as the supported surfaces, then narrow or close this request separately.

options.title: Defer unified lineage design
options.body: Pause implementation until spawned-session chains, resolver-family lineage, recursive listing, tree views, and lifecycle cleanup share one explicit design.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow chain metadata
recommendation.body: Add optional rootSessionKey and traceId as a bounded spawned-session chain contract with native/ACP spawn derivation and list projections, while deferring traversal and UI APIs.
